How old is Obi Toppin?

Obi Toppin is 28 years old.

Where was Obi Toppin born?

Obi Toppin was born in Brooklyn, New York.

When was Obi Toppin born?

Obi Toppin was born on March 4, 1998.

How tall is Obi Toppin?

Obi Toppin is 6-9 (206 cm) tall.

How much does Obi Toppin weigh?

Obi Toppin weighs 220 lbs (99 kg).

Is Obi Toppin in the Hall of Fame?

Obi Toppin is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Obi Toppin drafted?

Obi Toppin was drafted by New York Knicks, 1st round (8th pick, 8th overall), 2020 NBA Draft.

What position does Obi Toppin play?

Power Forward.

Obi Toppin has made at least $49,093,492 playing professional basketball.

What is Obi Toppin's Instagram account?

Obi Toppin is on Instagram at obitoppin_1.

What schools did Obi Toppin attend?
